items.title: Unrestricted File Upload in Adobe Commerce (APSB26-73)
items.summary: A critical unrestricted file upload vulnerability (CVSS 9.6) in Adobe Commerce could allow an attacker to upload arbitrary executable files.

items.title: Improper Output Encoding in Adobe Commerce (APSB26-73)
items.summary: A critical improper output encoding vulnerability (CVSS 9.1) in Adobe Commerce could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce (APSB26-73)
items.summary: A critical stored XSS vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) affecting standard Adobe Commerce stores allows malicious code injection that persists in the database.

items.title: Unauthenticated Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce (APSB26-73)
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 8.6) requires no authentication and allows an anonymous attacker to bypass security features.

items.title: Unauthenticated Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce (APSB26-73)
items.summary: Another critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 8.2) that requires no authentication, potentially allowing unauthorized actions.

items.title: Stored Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) in Adobe Commerce B2B (APSB26-73)
items.summary: A critical stored XSS vulnerability (CVSS 8.1) specifically impacts Adobe Commerce B2B deployments, allowing persistent malicious script injection.

items.title: Incorrect Authorization in Adobe Commerce (APSB26-73)
items.summary: A critical incorrect authorization vulnerability (CVSS 7.6) could allow unauthorized users to perform actions requiring higher privileges.

items.title: Improper Input Validation in Adobe Commerce (APSB26-73)
items.summary: A critical improper input validation vulnerability (CVSS 7.2) in Adobe Commerce could lead to various security bypasses or data manipulation.

items.title: Critical Vulnerability in Amasty Extensions
items.summary: Amasty released a massive security update for 25 extensions, including one critical vulnerability that could lead to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated Arbitrary File Upload in Amasty Order Attributes
items.summary: An unauthenticated arbitrary file upload flaw in Amasty Order Attributes allows attackers to write executable files to a Magento store without logging in, potentially leading to remote code execution.

items.title: Unauthenticated PHP Object Injection in Mirasvit Cache Warmer
items.summary: A critical (CVSS 9.8) unauthenticated PHP object injection vulnerability in Mirasvit Cache Warmer allows remote code execution via a crafted cookie.

items.title: Stored XSS leading to RCE in Adobe Commerce (APSB26-49)
items.summary: A critical stored XSS vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) in Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, and Magento Open Source could lead to arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Path Traversal leading to Arbitrary File Write in Adobe Commerce (APSB26-49)
items.summary: A critical path traversal vulnerability (CVSS 8.7) in Adobe Commerce, Adobe Commerce B2B, and Magento Open Source could allow arbitrary file system writes.
